decisions: Perform the deliberate process restart after the first update, verify update two against uninterrupted continuation, and make a fixed early development measurement at 32. Complete both fits if safe and retain matched exposure on resource stop. Estimate from 0.154/0.231 s per 121-token K=1/3 training gradient; 565k input and target positions per arm under the 18,000 s shared fit ceiling. Quantify realized cost independently. Gate promotion on complete public generation.
